# DDB Foodtech

DDB Foodtech is a food technology brand targeting extreme travelers and outdoor adventure enthusiasts. Their product — an 'extreme sandwich' — is positioned as a bold, adventure-ready food solution for people who push boundaries. The brand identity combines rugged outdoor energy with innovative food-tech, appealing to active, on-the-go consumers who demand performance from everything — including their food.

# The ExtremeSandwichFor ExtremeTravelers



### Food-tech performance engineered for people in motion



Rugged portability meets cutting-edge food innovation. DDB Foodtech delivers sustained energy, bold taste, and expedition-grade convenience — built for adventurers who never stop moving.

How It Works
























Field-Tested Performance

## Engineered for theExtreme Traveler


The DDB Extreme Sandwich isn't just food — it's precision-built fuel for athletes, adventurers, and anyone who refuses to slow down. Three core pillars define why it performs where everything else fails.

















### Built for Movement


Designed to fit any pack, pocket, or belt clip. The DDB Extreme Sandwich moves with you — no wrappers to fumble, no crumbling under pressure.

Lightweight carry — under 200g, zero bulk














### Engineered Shelf Resilience


HPP beverage processing technology meets extreme food engineering. Stays fresh through heat, cold, and altitude without refrigeration or preservatives.

Survives 60°C heat & sub-zero freeze cycles














### Bold Trail-Ready Taste


Flavor engineered to perform under exertion. High-density macros meet bold seasoning profiles — because the best food for extreme hiking trips can't taste like compromise.

No-fuss consumption — eat straight from pack












### Lightweight Carry






### No-Fuss Consumption






### Engineered Convenience






### Field-Proven Nutrition


























WHY DDB EXTREME SANDWICH



## BUILT FOR THOSE WHOREFUSE TO SLOW DOWN


Most food fails before the adventure does. DDB Foodtech engineered the Extreme Sandwich for athletes, trekkers, and explorers who demand the same performance from their food as they do from their gear. No compromises. No fragile packaging. No excuses.










### FREEDOM FROM FRAGILE FOOD


Forget bruised sandwiches and crushed snacks at the bottom of your pack. The Extreme Sandwich is engineered to survive drops, pressure, and temperature swings — so the only thing you need to worry about is the summit.











### CONFIDENCE IN ANY CONDITION


Extreme outdoor adventure food for athletes who operate in unpredictable environments. Whether you're deep in the backcountry or racing a trail clock, DDB delivers consistent, high-density fuel that matches the intensity of the moment.











### FOOD TECH THAT THINKS FORWARD


DDB Foodtech is committed to next-generation food science — minimal waste, maximum nutrition density, and ingredients that respect both the athlete and the environment. The best food for extreme hiking trips shouldn't cost the planet.












DDB Extreme Sandwich — field-tested, expedition-ready





















Field Reports



## Tested Where It Counts


Real feedback from athletes and adventurers who rely on extreme outdoor adventure food to fuel their toughest missions — not just their morning commute.


















"Three days above the snowline, no resupply, temperatures at minus fourteen. I've carried freeze-dried rations on expeditions for a decade — nothing has ever packed this much actual flavour and caloric density into something I could eat with gloves on. The DDB Extreme Sandwich didn't just survive the conditions. It performed. That's the only word for it."




MK



### Expedition Guide

Marcus Kellner
High-Altitude Mountaineer · 12 Expeditions



















"Mile 68 of a 100-mile ultra and I pulled one out of my vest pocket. Still intact. Ate it in under two minutes without breaking stride. The macros are dialled for sustained effort — this is the best food for extreme hiking trips I've ever carried."




SR



### Trail Runner

Sofia Ramos
100-Mile Ultramarathon Athlete
















"I spend weeks at a time in locations with zero infrastructure. Resupply is a luxury. The packaging is bulletproof, the shelf-life is serious, and — this matters — it actually tastes like food. Not cardboard. Not paste. Food. DDB cracked something real here."




JT



### Remote Hiker

Jonas Thiel
Wilderness Traverse Specialist · Patagonia & Alaska

# Privacy Policy



Last Updated:  5/22/2026



DDB Foodtech ("Company", "we", "our") is committed to protecting your privacy. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use and protect your information when you use our website [business_website] ("Service").


## 1. Information Collection


We may collect the following types of information:


- Personal Information: Name, email address, phone number and address

- Technical Information: IP address, browser type, operating system and website usage data

- Cookies: Information stored on your computer to improve user experience




## 2. Use of Information


We use the collected information for the following purposes:


- Providing requested services

- Improving service and user experience

- Contacting you regarding our services

- Compliance with legal requirements




## 3. Information Sharing


We do not sell, rent or share your personal information with third parties, except in the following cases:


- With your explicit consent

- When required by law

- To protect our rights or user safety

- With service providers who assist in operating the service (under confidentiality agreements)




## 4. User Rights


In accordance with Israeli Privacy Protection Law 1981, you have the following rights:


- Right to access personal information stored about you

- Right to correct inaccurate or incomplete information

- Right to delete personal information in certain circumstances

- Right to object to information processing for marketing purposes

- Right to file a complaint with the Data Protection Authority




## 5. Cookies


Our website uses cookies to improve user experience. You can manage cookies through your browser settings. Disabling cookies may affect website functionality.


## 6. Information Security


We implement reasonable security measures to protect your information, including encryption, firewalls and restricted access control. However, no transmission or storage method is 100% secure.


## 7. Policy Changes


We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Material changes will be posted on the website with 30 days advance notice.



## 8. Contact Information


For questions or requests regarding this privacy policy, please contact us:


- Company: DDB Foodtech

- Email: [business_email]

- Phone: [business_phone]

- Address: [business_address]



Data Protection Authority: For complaints, you may contact the Data Protection Authority at the Ministry of Justice

# Accessibility Statement



Last updated:  May 22, 2026



DDB Foodtech is committed to making our services accessible to all users. We strive to implement the Israeli Standard (TI 5568) based on WCAG 2.1 Level AA guidelines.


Accessibility Level: AA (Israeli Standard TI 5568)



## 1. Accessibility Policy


We believe in equal rights and the right of every person to receive information and services independently and equally. This website was designed and built with special emphasis on accessibility for people with disabilities.


## 2. Accessibility Arrangements on the Site


- Keyboard navigation support

- Screen reader compatibility

- Appropriate color contrast

- Flexible and scalable font sizes

- Descriptive image alt text

- Hierarchical heading structure

- Clear and descriptive links

- Support for 200% zoom without content loss





### WCAG 2.1 Compliance


The website complies with WCAG 2.1 Level AA, which includes:


- Perceivable: Information is presented in ways users can perceive

- Operable: Interface components are operable

- Understandable: Information and user interface are understandable

- Robust: Content can be interpreted by a variety of technologies





## 3. Supported Assistive Technologies


- NVDA (Windows)

- JAWS (Windows)

- VoiceOver (Mac/iOS)

- TalkBack (Android)

- Dragon NaturallySpeaking

- Switch navigation




## 4. Accessibility Testing


The website has been tested using:


- Automated accessibility testing tools

- Manual testing with screen readers

- Keyboard-only navigation

- Color contrast verification

- Testing with users with disabilities




## 5. Continuous Improvements


We are continuously working to improve the accessibility of our website and update it according to technological developments and user feedback.



## 6. Contact and Feedback


If you encounter an accessibility issue on the site or need assistance, please contact us:


- Company: DDB Foodtech

- Email: [business_email]

- Phone: [business_phone]



Response time: We respond to accessibility inquiries within 3 business days and work to resolve issues within 10 business days.
